title: Caderno do teste — o que o dono foi encontrando
summary: Chronological live-testing logbook capturing what the owner found while walking the system, mixing findings, decisions, and requirements.
notes: Prose-heavy chronological test notebook. Contains '## Decisão' and '## Requisito' sections, but structured as running observational notes rather than a single locked ADR or a formal PRD/SPEC.
